content:
## The Reality of Google PMax in 2025

Google Performance Max (PMax) has consolidated what used to be distinct Search, Shopping, Display, Discovery, and YouTube campaigns into a single unified machine learning pipeline. While Google promises hands-off automation, leaving PMax completely unmanaged leads to branded search cannibalization and budget waste on low-margin products.

To scale profitably, growth teams must implement strict structural guardrails.

---

## Asset Group Segmentation by Margin & Velocity

Rather than bundling your entire product catalog into one broad asset group, segment your campaigns according to **gross margin tiers** and **sales velocity**:

1. **Tier 1 (High-Margin Flagships)**: Allocate higher Target ROAS headroom (e.g. 350-400%) to capture aggressive search impression share.
2. **Tier 2 (Volume Drivers)**: Calibrate for conversion volume with flexible Target CPA constraints.
3. **Tier 3 (Clearance & Long-Tail)**: Run dedicated feed-only (no video/display creative assets) asset groups to prevent speculative display spend.

---

## Brand Exclusion Lists & Negative Keywords

By default, PMax aggressively bids on your own brand name to claim easy conversion credit. Always apply an **Account-Level Negative Keyword List** containing:
- Your exact brand name and common misspellings.
- Existing customer support queries (e.g. "tracking", "customer care", "returns").
- Negative competitors whose average order value does not align with your unit economics.
